opening: The salt-stained ceramic panel had crossed the North Annex conservation workshop before anyone noticed the fresh damage: intake, imaging, solvent, drying, and documentation. Its handling trail survived in fragments—camera angles, access times, treatment notes, token counts, and seals. Since casual impressions had produced too many plausible explanations, the reviewers agreed to trust only the local rules and the recovered records.

scenes.prose: Before opening the evidence packets, the board declared the certified restoration lead protocol active for this incident. Ordinary rank and reputation did not count. A second, older-looking provenance worksheet governed the workshop’s comparative tally: stable counted as 0, latent as 1, open as 2, dormant as 3, clear as 4, and waking as 5. The local tally began at 9. In order, it used relation, temporal, causal, spatial, sequence, and protocol statuses with coefficients 13, 3, 7, 5, 11, and 2. At each stream, the clerk squared the current tally, added the coefficient times that stream’s status value, and kept the remainder modulo 97. The clerk made three passes without resetting: first in the stated order, then backward with the coefficients reversed, and then forward again with the coefficient list rotated one place left. That complete three-pass cycle was repeated 118 times. Beside this provenance exercise, the incident board identified a separate six-code docket: relation, temporal, causal, spatial, sequence, and protocol, each coded only 0 or 1, processed from x=0 by x=(17x+code) mod 101. No other codes or outside credentials were permitted.
scenes.title: The Rules on the Glass Board

scenes.prose: In the pairing room, a recovered sheet placed Logan Meier’s apprentice lineage at clear, while a torn roster still marked Morgan Brooks’s lineage stable. The same packet gave Mara a supported relation, though the intake timing did not support her temporal claim; a later handling note supported her causal link, and the imaging-room route supported her spatial link. Her sequence entry failed, but the seal register supported her protocol step. Ivo’s time-stamped access interval supported his temporal status, and the solvent sign-out supported his causal status; the pairing record did not support his relation, the room map did not support his spatial placement, his transfer sequence was supported, and his protocol mark was absent. A clock-backed entry listed Logan Hassan’s work interval as waking. The chemical response that followed Kai Patel registered as latent, while causal review marked Yael Nguyen’s response open. Door and route checks placed Logan Meier’s workshop room at dormant, and corridor witnesses put Morgan Brooks’s room at clear. Reconstruction kept Logan Hassan’s treatment order latent. A close photograph set Kai Patel’s tool stamp to waking, while Yael Nguyen’s final token count left her stamp latent.
scenes.title: Pairing Sheets and Doorways

scenes.prose: The sealed worksheet shifted attention to the treatment bench. A roster witness left Seline with a supported relation, and her clock record also supported the temporal claim; the solvent trail did not support her causal account, but the room-camera map supported her spatial placement. Her treatment order was supported, while the protocol signature was not. Tomas’s pairing entry failed to support his relation, and his timing record failed as well; nevertheless, the tool-and-solvent trail supported his causal account, the camera map placed him in the relevant room, his transfer sequence held, and his seal was valid. The same witness check left Kai Patel’s apprentice lineage open, while clerks wrote dormant beside Yael Nguyen’s. Clocked entries put Logan Meier’s work interval at clear, and the sequence sheet showed Morgan Brooks’s interval open. Downstream checks tied Logan Hassan to a stable chemical response. A movement sketch marked Kai Patel’s room stable, while the route ledger tied Yael Nguyen’s room to open. In the ordered log, Logan Meier’s treatment order appeared stable; Morgan Brooks’s appeared waking. Inventory counted Logan Hassan’s tool stamp open.
scenes.title: The Sealed Worksheet

scenes.prose: At the drying rack, Mara’s causal and spatial notes were accepted by the reviewers, while her failed timing and sequence entries remained crossed out; the relation and seal records supported her. Ivo’s access time and transfer order held, but his room placement, relation, and protocol mark did not, even though the chemical trail supported his account. Seline’s route and transfer sequence remained supported, her timing and relation records stood, but her causal and protocol records did not. Tomas’s room placement, causal trail, transfer order, and seal all survived the comparison. Jun’s intake pairing was supported, while his timing, chemical response, and room placement were not; his treatment order and protocol seal were supported. In the earlier pairing note, Logan Hassan carried a waking apprentice lineage. After the timesheet review, Kai Patel’s interval stayed dormant, while reconciled timing notes kept Yael Nguyen’s interval stable. Instruments tracing Logan Meier’s action left the chemical response waking; when Morgan Brooks acted, it came back dormant. Location review left Logan Hassan’s room latent. Sequence notes placed Kai Patel’s treatment order clear, and Yael Nguyen’s dormant. Token and seal checks left Logan Meier’s tool stamp stable; Morgan Brooks’s sealed check showed dormant.
scenes.title: Tokens Under the Drying Rack

scenes.prose: The provenance subfile carried an accepted tally of 2. Its final definition was strict: the certified restoration lead was the one person whose six-stream tally equaled that accepted tally. The current incident board, however, preserved its own accepted docket checksum, 69, for the six binary evidence codes described at the opening. The reviewers therefore kept both calculations sealed until every record had been entered: the provenance tally could not be replaced by reputation, and the incident certification could not be awarded for any reason other than its checksum match. No name was read aloud when the folder was closed.
scenes.title: The Unopened Result

title: Certified Restoration Lead — Case 10003
